title: 第七章 被“潜规则”的李雪（求追读）
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“咔！”

“李雪你演的太过了，第一次接触碎尸案发现场，不要演惊恐。真实反映是强压反胃，脸色发白，视线躲闪，越克制越贴近人设。”

苏行舟在监视器旁边皱着眉头喊了停。

五百对他这种越俎代庖的行为已经习惯，苏行舟每次介入给的建议都是最合适的。

虽然导演的权力被稀释了很多，但是五百现在已经服气，只要跟着苏行舟走，这部剧的质量就不会差。

“对不起五百导演，苏总，我再来一次。”

李雪把额前刘海理了理，调整自己的状态。

这次是和苏行舟第三次合作，但感觉和以前完全不一样。

无论是在专业性，节奏上都是质的飞跃，就连潘岳明这样的老油条都对他的专业赞不绝口。

看到整个剧组运转得像机器一样严谨高效，李雪当然不愿意因为自己拖后腿。

苏行舟看她找到状态点了点头。

李雪还是有灵气的，这半年来还报了演技班，一点就通。

调整好后把现场交换给五百，苏行舟只做关键节点的介入。

叮铃铃~

苏行舟接到钟大强的电话。

“喂，钟叔。”

“行舟，姜逸磊那边同意见一面细聊，她要求尽快，随时有时间。”

“好。”

在苏行舟预料之中。

网站能为她打造两档节目，而且还可以谈分成合同，目前对未来迷茫的papi酱不可能不急。

要知道，哪怕大鹏在搜狐也拿不到分成合同，是按月领工资的底薪。

这个条件，papi打遍灯笼也找不到。

现在是互联网时代了，个人IP越发重要，如果不用分成条件绑定，深入合作的话，以papi的能力绝对是迅速走红然后另起炉灶。

把条件谈拢，尽快把第一期节目做出来。

苏行舟也需要尽快回击网民，在反转之前炒热舆论。

这几天随着潘岳明进组的消息传出去，外面骂得越来越凶了。

【悲哀啊，这种人渣居然还能有拍戏，果然娱乐圈一路货色。】

【这不就是娱乐圈的尿性吗？为了热度无下限。】

【不是娱乐圈的错，是苏行舟的问题，大家都在为董婕发声，只有这个败类是圈子之耻！】

【苏行舟一个北电大一新生，有什么资格代表娱乐圈，如果不是继承了他爸的公司，他就是路边。】

【北电要反思一下了，教出这样的学生，是不是代表整个学校的风气就是这样？】

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Click!"

"Li Xue, you overacted. It's your first time to come across the scene of a mutilated corpse crime. Don't act frightened. The real reaction is to feel nauseated, your face turns pale, and your eyes dodge. The more restrained you are, the closer to the character you are."

Su Xingzhou frowned and shouted stop next to the monitor.

Wubai was used to his overstepping behavior, and every time Su Xingzhou intervened, the advice he gave was the most appropriate.

Although the director's power has been diluted a lot, Wubai is now convinced that as long as he follows Su Xingzhou, the quality of this drama will not be bad.

"I'm sorry, Director Five Hundred, Mr. Su, I'll do it again."

Li Xue straightened her bangs on her forehead and adjusted herself.

This is the third time I have collaborated with Su Xingzhou, but the feeling is completely different from before.

It is a qualitative leap in terms of professionalism and rhythm. Even veterans like Pan Yueming are full of praise for his professionalism.

Seeing that the entire crew was operating as rigorously and efficiently as a machine, Li Xue certainly didn't want to be held back by herself.

Su Xingzhou nodded when he saw that she was in good condition.

Li Xue is still smart. She has even signed up for acting classes in the past six months, and she can get through it with just a few clicks.

After adjusting, the scene was transferred to Wubai, and Su Xingzhou only intervened at key nodes.

Jingle bell bell~

Su Xingzhou received a call from Zhong Daqiang.

"Hey, Uncle Zhong."

"Xingzhou, Jiang Yilei agreed to meet and have a detailed chat. She asked for it as soon as possible. She has time at any time."

"Okay."

Su Xingzhou expected it.

The website can create two programs for her, and can also negotiate a share-sharing contract. Papi Jiang, who is currently confused about the future, cannot be in a hurry.

You know, even if Dapeng is in Sohu, he will not get a share-sharing contract, but a basic salary on a monthly basis.

Papi couldn't find this condition even after searching all over the lanterns.

Now is the Internet era, and personal IP is becoming more and more important. If there is no conditional binding and in-depth cooperation, Papi's ability will definitely become popular quickly and start a new business.

Negotiate the conditions and produce the first episode as soon as possible.

Su Xingzhou also needs to respond to netizens as soon as possible and stir up public opinion before reversing.

In the past few days, as the news of Pan Yueming joining the group spread, the criticism outside has become more and more fierce.

[It’s sad that such a scumbag can still film. Sure enough, the entertainment industry is full of shit.】

[Isn’t this the urine of the entertainment industry?There is no lower limit for the popularity.】

[It’s not the entertainment industry’s fault, it’s Su Xingzhou’s problem. Everyone is speaking out for Dong Jie. Only this scum is the shame of the industry!】

[Su Xingzhou, a freshman from Nortel University, has no qualifications to represent the entertainment industry. If he hadn't inherited his father's company, he would be on the roadside.】

[Nortel needs to reflect on this. Does teaching such students mean that this is the ethos of the entire school?】
